composition.serve_who: This sheet serves the vessel's bilge management system, specifically detailing the control logic, valve actuation, and monitoring for the five main bilge compartments (Lazarette, Aft, Engine Room, Forward, Sail Locker) and the main bilge pump. The evidence is the drawing title 'BILGE SYSTEM', the repeating 'BILGE VALVE' loads, and the 'BILGE PUMP SW' control loops.

equipment_groups.placement_reasoning: The sheet explicitly illustrates the control loops, relays, and limit switch feedback for the motorized bilge valves serving the vessel's five distinct bilge zones.

functions.label: Lazarette Bilge Valve Control
functions.what_it_does: Opens or closes to connect the lazarette bilge to the main suction manifold, providing status feedback to the main panel and monitoring system.

flow_scenarios.path: Commanded from MAIN PANEL switch S20 via PLUG C pin 1, activating relay Re1 (supplied by BILGE VALVES Q13 10A) to drive the valve motor (M) via T/S C terminals 9 and 10.
Limit switches send status feedback via T/S C terminals 7 (open) and 8 (closed) to MAIN PANEL indicators via PLUG D pins 1 and 2, and to the ONYX monitoring system via taps XA40 <14> and XA40 <12>.

functions.dry_data: Burkert 2-way DN050 electric rotary actuators; 24V DC control.

equipment_groups.placement_reasoning: The sheet details the multi-source activation control loop for the main bilge pump contactor/solenoid.

functions.label: Pump Activation Control
functions.what_it_does: Closes the pump's power contactor based on local, remote, or automated commands.

flow_scenarios.path: Fed from +24V SERVICE BAT via breaker F3 60A and isolation switch SW8. The contactor coil circuit (via T/S S terminals 13 and 14) is closed by ANY of three parallel paths: (1) LOCAL PUMP SW via T/S C terminals 1 and 2; (2) MAIN PANEL switch S13 via PLUG C pins 6 and 7; or (3) ONYX automated remote command XA11 <32> switched through relay Re6 via T/S C terminal 50.

functions.dry_data: Gianneschi ACB 431 B; 24V DC control loop.
functions.sheet_region: Top Left to Terminal Strip T/S C

facts: Houses the Bilge System PC Card, interfacing with field wiring via multi-pin PLUG C and PLUG D.
Provides manual toggle switches (S20-S24) for individual operation of the five bilge valves, and switch S13 for the main bilge pump.
Contains local LED indicators for the open/closed status of each bilge valve (derived from PLUG D inputs 1-10).
Includes an AUX PLUG ON PC BOARD outputting from PLUG C pins 8-11.
Contains the main control relay bank (Re1-Re6) used to switch power to the bilge valve motors and handle the ONYX remote pump command.
Houses terminal strips T/S B, T/S C (50 pins), and T/S S, consolidating all field wiring from valve limit switches, motors, and remote commands.

uncertainties: The exact nature of component 'SO 6' located in the top-left pump supply line (between SW8 and T/S S) is unclear; it is drawn as a crossed box but lacks a definitive descriptive label.
